column1: # Design cases (load combinations) for the EC3 checks.
# A design case is a factored sum of Strand7 result cases. One row per term:
# design_case : name of the design case; use the same name on every row of the case
# result_file : full path to the result file; leave blank for the default result file
# result_case : result case NUMBER in that file (see the list printed by step2_forces.py
#               or member_forces.py); combination cases made by Strand7 can be used too
# factor      : multiplier for that case (negative values are allowed
# Results from LINEAR static files (.LSA) can be added together.
# Results from any other file type (nonlinear etc.) cannot be superposed: they must be
# a design case on their own
